ينتجب (form VIII)
# يَنْتَجِبُ (yantajibu) /jan.ta.d͡ʒi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# يُنْتَجَبُ (yuntajabu) /jun.ta.d͡ʒa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# يَنْتَجِبَ (yantajiba) /jan.ta.d͡ʒi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
